summary: Reproduced the exact candidate's missing production resolver path and unsupported-metric KeyError, then preserved its valid framework while adding opt-in request-boundary manifest resolution, reversible regional compilation for eager fallback, Hunyuan3D lazy-load integration, and fail-closed unsupported metric handling. Candidate parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2913. Review parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2983.

tests.command: candidate ced86c26 direct import plus production rg audit (see raw/failing_before.log)
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced KeyError for an unsupported tensor metric and found no production CompilePlanResolver construction; all production _maybe_torch_compile callers omitted resolved_plan.
22 unit/regression tests passed, covering manifests, signature mismatches, request signature derivation, unsupported metric rejection, region inventory, and compiled-wrapper eager/compiled switching.
Repository isort, ruff, formatting, AST, codespell, and policy hooks passed.
Real ROCm/Inductor four-step toy trajectory on AMD Instinct MI355X: maximum absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-07, reset/short-history passed, and an intentional step-1 perturbation was rejected.

gpu_evidence: reports/j-b7646a3f6bf9/raw/gpu_trajectory_gate.log records torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 on AMD Instinct MI355X and the complete numerical report.
remaining_limitations: No production diffusion or stateful world-model weights or promoted manifests were available; no architecture or semantic accuracy claim is made.
History-length regimes, cache on/off, CFG serial/parallel, production reset isolation, mutation/alias metadata, semantic output metrics, and distributed topology remain unqualified.
Manifest-backed serving is opt-in and requires explicit immutable model revision, state schema version, and gate digest configuration; ordinary compile policy is unchanged when manifests are absent.
The GPU harness is a deterministic Linear/tanh toy and cannot qualify a production model architecture.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
